grant_resource_matches_scope.name: grant_resource_matches_scope
grant_resource_matches_scope.value: ("access_grants"."scope" IN ('upload', 'spectator') AND "access_grants"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "access_grants"."content_version_id" IS NULL) OR ("access_grants"."scope" IN ('watch', 'review') AND "access_grants"."content_version_id" IS NOT NULL AND "access_grants"."session_id" IS NULL)

asset_owner_present.name: asset_owner_present
asset_owner_present.value: "assets"."owner_clerk_id" IS NOT NULL OR "assets"."upload_grant_id" IS NOT NULL

asset_dimensions_positive.name: asset_dimensions_positive
asset_dimensions_positive.value: ("assets"."width" IS NULL OR "assets"."width" > 0) AND ("assets"."height" IS NULL OR "assets"."height" > 0)

content_ready_has_media.name: content_ready_has_media
content_ready_has_media.value: "content_versions"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("content_versions"."asset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "content_versions"."media_metadata" IS NOT NULL)
